method: regime-dummy regression of CP YoY growth on REFERENCE (NBER+) regime windows; mean+std per regime
caveat: CP is aggregate; its std understates single-company EBITDA dispersion. The regime-conditional mean is well identified; std is a lower bound.

multiple_compression.method: Analyst assumption: regime-conditional EV/EBITDA multiple re-rating applied on top of the calibrated EBITDA shock. NOT calibrated from data — no point-in-time market-multiple series is ingested. This term is the dominant driver of modeled crisis severity (~95% of the mean crisis decline in recoverable value); see docs/limitations.md before treating crisis output as calibrated.
